new.brief: Returns a newly created `GtkGesture` that recognizes swipes.
new.md: Returns a newly created `GtkGesture` that recognizes swipes.

doc.md:
Recognizes swipe gestures.

After a press/move/.../move/release sequence happens, the
[`GestureSwipe::swipe`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureSwipe#event:swipe) signal will be emitted,
providing the velocity and directionality of the sequence
at the time it was lifted.

If the velocity is desired in intermediate points,
[`GestureSwipe.get_velocity()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.GestureSwipe#method:get_velocity) can be called in a
[`Gesture::update`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Gesture#event:update) handler.

All velocities are reported in pixels/sec units.

get_velocity.md:
Gets the current velocity.

If the gesture is recognized, this function returns `TRUE` and fills
in `velocity_x` and `velocity_y` with the recorded velocity, as per the
last events processed.

swipe.brief: Emitted when the recognized gesture is finished.
swipe.md:
Emitted when the recognized gesture is finished.

Velocity and direction are a product of previously recorded events.
